title: Well-Formed Boolean Program
statement: Let $n,w$ be natural numbers, let $F$ assign an output list to each instruction kind and Boolean input list, and let a program be a finite list of instructions. The program is well formed if, for every instruction at position $i$ in the program and every source used by that instruction, each input-bit index is less than $n$, every constant is allowed, and every referenced earlier block has index less than $i$ and bit index less than $w$.
hypotheses_covered: function F from an instruction kind and a Boolean list to a Boolean list
